channel.title: UKTN
channel.description: Recorded fixture feed. All companies are fictional.

item.title: Hedgerow Labs raises £2.4m seed round for SME carbon accounting
item.description: Shoreditch-based Hedgerow Labs has closed a £2.4m seed round to help lenders measure the climate footprint of small business loan books. The round was led by a London climate fund.

item.title: Quillstone AI raises £750k pre-seed to take the grind out of contract negotiation
item.description: Farringdon legal tech startup Quillstone AI has raised a £750k pre-seed round for its clause negotiation copilot aimed at in-house legal teams.

item.title: Brockwell Health raises £3m seed round for menopause care
item.description: Brixton-based Brockwell Health has secured £3m in seed funding to expand its menopause care platform across the UK, pairing patients with specialist clinicians.

item.title: Marrowbone Robotics raises £8.5m Series A to automate dark kitchens
item.description: Hackney Wick robotics company Marrowbone Robotics has raised an £8.5m Series A to scale its kitchen automation arms into delivery-only restaurant sites.

item.title: Chornozem Analytics raises $5m seed round to map soil health across Ukraine
item.description: Kyiv-based agritech startup Chornozem Analytics has raised $5m to expand its satellite soil monitoring platform for farms across Ukraine.

item.title: Thamesline Security raises £24m Series B to expand its SOC platform
item.description: London cybersecurity scaleup Thamesline Security has closed a £24m Series B to grow its managed security operations platform into Europe.
